# Layout and containers

## window

Keywords: `window`.

A desktop window with a title bar.

Content: yes. Container: yes.
Options: `fill`, `w=number`, `h=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text
window: Settings
  text: Profile
```

## dialog

Keywords: `dialog`, `modal`.

A dialog with a title bar, a close control and a shadow.

Content: yes. Container: yes.
Options: `fill`, `w=number`, `h=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text
dialog: Remove member?
  buttons: Cancel | *Remove
```

## browser

Keywords: `browser`.

A browser window: 'title | address'.

Content: yes. Container: yes.
Options: `fill`, `w=number`, `h=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text
browser: Team | example.com
  text: Members
```

## phone

Keywords: `phone`.

A phone screen with a status bar and an optional app bar title.

Content: yes. Container: yes.
Options: `fill`, `w=number`, `h=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text

  text: Anna
```

## box

Keywords: `box`, `panel`, `group`.

A frame around the components under it, with an optional title bar.

Content: yes. Container: yes.
Options: `fill`, `plain`, `dark`, `collapsible`, `collapsed`, `w=number`, `h=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text
box: Details
  text: Account
```

## row

Keywords: `row`.

The components under it side by side.

Content: no. Container: yes.
Options: `fill`, `top`, `w=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text
row:
  button: Save
```

## columns

Keywords: `columns`, `cols`.

The components under it side by side, all as tall as the tallest, touching.

Content: no. Container: yes.
Options: `fill`, `w=number`, `h=number`, `gap=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text

  box: Navigation
```

## section

Keywords: `section`.

A header line with a count and a chevron over the components under it.

Content: yes. Container: yes.
Options: `fill`, `collapsed`, `w=number`, `h=number`, `count=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text

  text: Anna
```

## tabs

Keywords: `tabs`, `tab`.

Tabs from | items, the starred one active, with a panel for the components under it.

Content: yes. Container: yes.
Options: `fill`, `segmented`, `underline`, `w=number`, `h=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text

  text: Your profile
```

## form

Keywords: `form`.

A box whose fields line up after one label column.

Content: yes. Container: yes.
Options: `fill`, `plain`, `dark`, `collapsible`, `collapsed`, `w=number`, `h=number`, `label=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text

  field: Name | input: Anna
```

## field

Keywords: `field`.

A label before one component: 'field: Name | input: Anna'. Without the |, field: is an input.

Content: yes. Container: no.
Options: `fill`, `floating`, `required`. Also takes the common flags and an id.

```text
field: Name | input: Anna
```

## details

Keywords: `details`, `properties`.

A detail list: one 'label | value' pair per line.

Content: yes. Container: no.
Options: `fill`, `stacked`, `w=number`. Also takes the common flags and an id.
